description:
Pre-GIP-0088 surrogate. Skips Phase 3 in graph-contracts/run.sh (no REO / IssuanceAllocator / RecurringAgreementManager deployment) and drops the optional rewards-eligibility + indexing-payments services. Light smoke target; not the heavy-test path.

LIMITATIONS:
  - Contract BYTECODE is identical to baseline — both use ghcr.io/graphprotocol/contracts:${CONTRACTS_VERSION}, which currently points at a post-audit-chain (post-GIP-0088) build. Only the on-chain DEPLOYMENT differs (Phase 3 absent). A test passing under `main` therefore does NOT prove behaviour against the actual mainnet contract surface.
  - Service-side image pins (graph-node, indexer-agent, indexer-service, etc.) match baseline. Off-chain components are upgraded in production anyway, so this is intentional.
  - REO governance / eligibility tests self-skip via `net.contracts.reo.is_none()` since REO isn't deployed.

KEY STEPS TO MAKE THIS FAITHFUL (deferred):
  1. Branch contracts from a pre-GIP-0088 ref point (mainnet-deployed contracts).
  2. Apply the minimum deployment-package + helper-task changes needed so gip-88's graph-contracts/run.sh Phase 1/2 still works against that branch (current local-network tooling assumes the deployment-package layout shipping with newer contracts).
  3. Publish the resulting workspace image.
  4. Override CONTRACTS_VERSION in this recipe to point at it.
